title: Redeeming Owner Rewards Points Toward a Repair Order — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Scope.** For a redemption of the whole redeemable points balance toward the open repair order of a retail rewards account, this policy sets the redemption credit, and only for such a redemption; every other redemption is still made in whole points of at least the tier's fewest points per redemption, each worth the tier's point value, and may pay at most the tier's largest redemption share of the repair order's customer-pay labor and parts total, with the tier labor and parts discounts applied first and points paying part of what remains. A retail rewards account is a Service Accounts and Repair Orders account at a Kessler Owner Rewards tier.

**Prerequisites.**
- The redemption credit is fixed only after the records carry the points earned for every repair order on the account that has been paid in full and whose customer-pay labor charges, less the estimate overage, comeback, goodwill and rewards redemption credits on it, come to at least one dollar.
- The redemption credit is not fixed until the month-end points expiry run for the latest calendar month whose last day falls on or before the redemption date has been made.

**What is booked.** The redemption is booked as one points redemption of the redeemable points for the redemption credit, together with its rewards redemption credit on the open repair order. The points leave the rewards points balance and the credit lowers the amount owed on the account.

## Tool: `redeem_owner_points_3e3ce956`
**Capability.** The account holder redeems Owner Rewards points toward one of their own repair orders: the points are taken off the rewards points balance and a rewards redemption credit for the stated dollar amount is applied to the named repair order.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `redeem_owner_points_3e3ce956` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_account_id` | Reference number of the holder's service account, as returned by the service account lookup | Id |
| `repair_order_number` | Repair order number the points are applied to, copied from the repair order lines returned by the ledger lookup | Verbatim, character for character, no normalisation |
| `points` | Number of Owner Rewards points redeemed | Whole number (integer, no decimals, no separators), greater than zero |
| `credit_amount` | Dollar credit the redeemed points apply to the repair order | US dollars, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent (further digits are rounded half up), greater than zero, plain decimal notation with no currency sign, separators or exponent |

**Return.** A one-line receipt beginning with the word Redeemed, naming the redemption reference, the repair order number, the points redeemed, the credit applied, the resulting points balance and the resulting amount owed on the account. A string beginning with Error is returned, and nothing is booked, when `points` is not a whole number greater than zero or `credit_amount` is not a plain decimal amount greater than zero after rounding.
